count_scf_ionic_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
review_converged_oszicar: review the converged_oszicar function to understand how VASP electronic convergence is validated
refactor_converged_oszicar: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support custom convergence thresholds or additional DFT tools
summarize_count_scf: summarize the count_scf function that aggregates SCF and ionic step counts across OSZICAR files
